items.q: "Look, Mr. Weber, we come up to see what we have to do to be reinstated

ctx.x: Petrillo, yeah. And so it was Weber then x International

and we talked right to him. "Look, Mr. Weber, we come up to see what we have to do to be reinstated or whatever, and why, when we put in our two weeks notice." And he began to tell us, "Well, you guys had a contract out there to stay six months where you couldn't break it." Well, what did we know? So we said, "Well, we don't know how we're going to get back to work. When will we get back to work?" So he says, "Well, whenever you're ready to go out there and finish out that contract. Go back out there and finish…

And so Rosenberg had already followed us. See, where Rosenberg come in, he got to us before we went to California. He says, "Now, you're going to need somebody to represent you out there. You're going to be doing pictures and all that kind of stuff, you know." And then Stuff signed up with him. "You will need protection out there for 15 percent." Stuff signs up with him.
